# CogniElevate
> CogniElevate builds intelligent products and systems that reduce wasted time across productivity, shopping, healthcare, robotics and future markets.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://cognielevate.co/): Company overview, mission, products and the friction-reduction model.
- [About CogniElevate](https://cognielevate.co/about/): Company background, principles, outcomes and product ecosystem.
- [Products](https://cognielevate.co/products/): CogniFocus, Aptelle and the markets CogniElevate is exploring.
- [Founder](https://cognielevate.co/founder/): Qasim Khan, founder of CogniElevate.
- [Contact](https://cognielevate.co/contact/): Partnerships, feedback, product interest and future solution ideas.

## Products
- [CogniFocus](https://cognifocus.app/): An Android focus system with behavior-aware focus sessions, Distraction Shield app blocking, recovery nudges, streaks and XP.
- [Aptelle](https://aptelle.com/): CogniElevate's fit-intelligence product for finding the right size across clothing brands using body profile and fit data.

## Editorial content
- [Blog](https://cognielevate.co/blog/): Focus, productivity and intelligent-systems insights from the CogniElevate team.
- [Resources](https://cognielevate.co/resources/): Practical CogniFocus guides and early Aptelle resources.

## Entity facts
- Organization: CogniElevate
- Founder: Qasim Khan
- Primary product: CogniFocus, available for Android
- Next product: Aptelle, launching soon for clothing and shopping fit intelligence
- Contact: cognielevate@gmail.com
- Canonical domain: https://cognielevate.co/
